title: Warm Grassy Peruvian Wrap
description: A unique Peruvian dish inspired by the flavors of the Andean highlands, featuring a duck fat filling wrapped in a leafy relleno.
instructions: In a small saucepan, warm the duck fat over low heat.
Roast the rocoto peppers in the oven until charred, about 20 minutes.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool down.
Once cool, peel off the skin, remove the seeds, and chop the flesh.
In a large skillet, caramelize the onion over medium heat until golden brown, about 15 minutes.
Add the chopped cilantro, quinoa, grilled chicken, feta cheese, peruvian aji amarillo pepper paste, lime juice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Carefully place a leaf wrap on a work surface and spoon the duck fat mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Place a few pieces of the roasted rocoto pepper on top of the filling.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a neat package.
Place the wraps seam-side down on a baking sheet and brush with a little bit of duck fat.
Bake in the preheated oven until the wraps are crispy and golden brown, about 10-12 minutes.
